title: Verordnung zur Änderung der Aufenthaltsverordnung und der AZRG-Durchführungsverordnung vom 18. Dezember 2015 (BGBl. 2015 I Nr. 54, S. 2467), excerpt: preamble, Art. 1 No. 10 (Anlage C), Art. 3 and signature
in_force: Art. 1 No. 10 in force the day after promulgation (Art. 3(3)): promulgated 28 Dec 2015, so 29 Dec 2015
verified_how: curl was answered with an HTML shell that needs JavaScript (no PDF). The text was read on 2026-11-02 in a Chrome session that the repository owner (Meng Wong) directed Claude to drive; the gazette text is the PDF's own text layer as returned by the viewer's pdf.js. The browser's own download did not complete, so the PDF/page was NOT saved to disk and this file is the encoder's transcription of what the browser returned; it has not been compared with the original. Commons guide §8 treats a bot challenge as a 'no'; a browser read was used here with the owner's agreement, and whether that is acceptable under the guide is for Michael to say.
notes: German is the only authoritative language; any English in the encoding is a gloss.
